programmes.d: Yui catches a fever and is unable to practice for the festival. The club feels uneasy performing without her, but in the end everyone puts on a great performance.
Teiichi finds himself lost in the old hallways of Seikyou Academy, and stumbles upon the school's resident ghost, Yuko.
Yui wants to enjoy hot soup with the other girls, but they're all busy! Will Yui be forced to spend the cold winter holiday alone?
Teiichi receives a mysterious letter that leads him to meet Kirie, who warns him of Yuko's true nature.
Ritsu's old middle school friend invites the band to perform at a live house on New Year's Eve. How will the evening pan out?
The Paranormal Investigation Club holds a summer break training camp in the old school building to look into another ghost story.
Nozaki needs inspiration for his artwork so Sakura decides to take him on what she believes is a date, but a few awkward encounters make her reconsider.
Teiichi and his club host a haunted house for the school culture festival.
Posing manga characters is a never-ending challenge for Nozaki, but two of his models may become a real life couple!
The rumor of a masked blood-covered monster runs wild in the halls of Seikyou Academy, led by Yuko Kirishima.
Sakura and Nozaki find themselves living in a real-life manga, but while Sakura daydreams of romance it's no surprise to find that Nozaki is completely clueless.
Teiichi notices Yuko acting strange whenever she sees him spending time with Momoe; shadow Yuko makes an unexpected appearance.
The group has various repeated, awkward attempts at love, and it appears some people are catching on to who they are in Nozaki's manga.
Yuko tells Teiichi to keep his distance from her after an unfortunate incident; Kirie thinks that Yuko is sending her painful memories to her shadow self.
Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.
Teiichi and Kirie discover that Yuko has been pushing all her bad memories onto her shadow self; Yuko has no idea about any of the school's mysteries.
After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.
Teiichi finds himself sixty years in the past and experiences Yuko's final days as a human; as she slips into the abyss, a dark sensation takes hold.
Yuu doesn't know which club to join, so her teacher suggests she join the student council. There, she finds a friend in Touko, and perhaps something more...
After returning from the past, Teiichi and Yuko are unable to see or hear each other; they have to rely on the club's logbook to communicate.
Yuu wonders if she's cut out to be a campaign manager while Touko makes amends. Communication will cultivate a relationship, regardless of the situation.
With all the mysteries surrounding her life and death solved, Yuko is finally whole; Yuko must choose to pass on or stay with Teiichi as a ghost.
Yuu keeps telling herself there's no way she's joining the student council. Touko wants to stop by a bookstore on her way home and is in for a surprise.
The Demon Lord is defeated by a human hero; to find his replacement, the demon kin hold a competition; Helck, a human and mortal enemy, is among the participants.
Touko wants to bring back the Student Council Stage Show for the first time in seven years at the school's culture festival. But Yuu and Maki have their reservations.
Helck continues to rack up victories as a fan favorite of the crowd; he proceeds on to the semifinals race.
When challenging an archnemesis to a duel, please make sure they do not mistake it as an invitation to hang out. It's awkward for everyone involved.
Helck displays a lot of strength and leaves Vermilio increasingly concerned about the threat he poses.
Mikan realizes something - she recognizes the box that seals Shamiko's dad. That means the factory ruins on the outskirts of town hold clues about Momo's sister! Maybe.
After Helck blocks an attack meant for Edil, Vermilio becomes convinced that he is an enemy; the floor gives way and everyone falls into a dark underground room.
After hearing that Lilith has been sealed for over 2000 years, Shamiko and Momo come up with a plan to let her borrow Shamiko's body and enjoy a day of freedom.
The power of the gate sends Vermilio and Helck to a remote island; Vermilio travels deeper into the island and comes across a fluffy creature.
Vermilio poses a question to Helck about fighting against old friends; the others at Castle Urum are fighting winged knights.
Shamiko visits a cafe rumored to be frequented by demons in search of clues about Sakura, but somehow ends up getting a part-time job instead!
Hyura and the others escape Castle Urum, but soon find themselves surrounded again; Azudra arrives to subdue the winged knights; Azudra begins plotting.
Shamiko learns that Lico and Shirosawa have a connection to Sakura and decides to continue working part-time at the cafe. However, Momo is vehemently opposed to it!
Azudra determines the winged knights are a major threat; Helck and Vermilio take it easy.
When Shamiko finds herself in trouble, the one who saves her is none other than Sakura Chiyoda! Meanwhile, Momo takes a certain action to save Shamiko from her nightmare.
Helck and Vermilio bid farewell to the mysterious island and its residents as they sail away with a stowaway Piwi aboard; they run into a massive whirlpool.
Shamiko's summer vacation has turned out far more hectic than intended. She tries to reclaim some peace in her life, but the looming stack of homework casts a dark shadow...
Helck and company end up in the Erille Kingdom where they must fight the barbarians of the Tothman Tribe; the Tothman King goes berserk after tapping into a mysterious power.
Shamiko promises to visit the zoo with Momo and Mikan and tries making boxed lunches for them. She'll need help to make something tasty, so Shamiko visits a certain address.
Helck and company use their winnings from the cooking competition to buy a map leading to the Empire; they make plans to go northwest into the ruins of two destroyed kingdoms.
Momo is stuck in her darkness form! Without the ability to control her strength, Momo unintentionally destroys whatever she touches.
Vermilio is frightened by Helck's power as he goes berserk during his battle with Augis; it makes her recall the words of the Great Witch who warned her about Helck.
Shamiko can't use her magic rod right because of a lack of imagination. Special training in Lilith's sealed space will help her. Maybe.
When they were little, Helck and his younger brother Cless lost both of their parents; one day, Cless gets very sick and Helck begs for someone to save him.
A chaotic summer break ends, and a new school semester begins with Mikan transferring into Shamiko's class.
Only half a month after Cless departs on his expedition, monsters begin to appear in greater numbers than ever before; the kingdom enacts a military draft to combat them.
Shamiko and Momo enter Mikan's heart to negotiate with Ugallu, the entity responsible for the magical girl's curse!
Helck arrives at the Demon Lord's castle and senses a powerful presence; it turns out to be Azudra of the Four Elite Lords, who makes a plea for peace.
The Student Council plans an open house at Seika High to boost female enrollment. However, a girl-hating freshman, Soutarou, goes to extreme measures to derail their efforts.
Zeruzeon reveals the kingdom's terrifying plan, so Helck and his friends sneak into the castle to put a stop to it by saving Cless.
Soutarou is shocked to find that Misaki was able to outlast his little game. Misaki has a special punishment in mind for the freshman at the upcoming Open House.
Helck is on the verge of being killed; to save the life of his big brother, Cless is forced to make a choice.
It's the summer vacation, and the Maid Latte crew has been invited to Satsuki's sister's beach resort. Aoi tags along, too, but why did Satsuki bring Usui?
Helck charges onward, but an army of bounty hunters stands between him and Alicia; she is in horrible shape as she faces public execution.
Helck's motivations become clear with an awakening of a horrific truth; Vermilio vows to fight by Helck's side.
It's the second day of vacation, and Aoi needs Misa's help to win the beach volleyball tournament! The winners are crowned Beach Prince and Princess, so why is Usui competing?
The winged knights continue attacking Castle Thor to level themselves up further; Asta keeps snooping for information in the human realm.
The Miyabigaoka Student Council aims to buy out Maid Latte and replace it with a butler cafe. The only way for Misa to stop this is to enter the footman auditions in disguise.
Zeruzeon leads the winged knights in an assault on the newly rebuilt castle; humans and demons become locked in combat.
Usui and Misaki must cooperate to succeed in the second round of the footman auditions, but before the third round begins, disaster strikes.
Hyura and Edil battle it out at Castle Thor while a strange relationship starts between them; Mikaros is confronted by Azudra and reveals a past grudge.
Yukimura's sister loves playing princess but her brother's not princely enough. She's smitten by Prince Usui, so Yukimura arranges a date for them to regain her favor.
Raphael's army attacks a demonkin outpost when Helck and Vermilio arrive; Raphael determines Vermilio is Helck's newfound source of support.
Misaki orders the sports clubs to clean up their club rooms. Meanwhile, a transfer student, Hinata Shintani, arrives and irks Misaki with his childish behavior and gluttony.
Helck faces off with his former friend, Alicia; Vermilio can't help but be concerned about Helck as she continues to fight with Raphael.
It's the school field trip, and the class has been tricked into hard work at a temple. The girls are curious about Misa and Hinata, while she has to keep him and Usui apart.

The second year of school begins! The Light Music Club tries to gather by any means necessary.
Life for Ayato Kamina seems normal enough, but when wars hits close to home, the life he once knew changes forever.
Azusa Nakano joins the Light Music Club but realizes that the laid-back club might not be for her, and Azusa's membership is at stake.
With the RahXephon awakened, the tide of war seems as if it is about to change; under the control of Ayato, the RahXephon easily eliminates the invading Dolem.
The girls go on another training camp with their new member. Despite Azusa's nagging, she's the one that plays the most.
Ayato discovers the shocking truth: his mother has blue blood; the RahXephon destroys another Dolem and creates a passage from Tokyo to the outside.
The annual school festival is getting closer and the Light Music club will be performing again... however, Mio and Ritsu get into an argument.
The pair have left the safety of Tokyo and now live on the outside; Ayato and Haruka are picked up by TERRA, the military group that she is a member of.
Yui catches a fever and is unable to practice for the festival. The club feels uneasy performing without her, but in the end everyone puts on a great performance.
